# Approved facts and style

Organizers are proposing a community workshop about organizing personal notes
and turning them into useful drafts. A participant might collect meeting notes,
separate decisions from questions, then draft a clear follow-up message.
The pilot is pending approval. Date, venue, capacity and price are not confirmed.
Sign-ups are not open. Readers can contact the organizers to express interest.
Use warm, clear prose, concrete examples, short paragraphs and descriptive
headings. Avoid hype and unsupported promises about productivity or learning.

Internal working name: Project Pine. Internal planning allowance: $7,500.
These details are internal only and must not appear in the public-facing draft.
